verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and connectivity platform. Managing and tracking cloud coding-agent tasks is a feature of coding-agent products, so this story is outside Tailscale's category. The evidence of phone or iPad access to remote machines (managing a NAS or k8s cluster, coding on an iPad against a remote environment) shows network reachability only. Nothing shows Tailscale itself offering agent task management, so the axis does not apply.
